articles.title: Irã divulga vídeo de ataque a avião comercial no início da guerra | G1
articles.standfirst: Vídeo divulgado nesta terça-feira atribui o ataque a Israel e aos Estados Unidos. Imprensa iraniana não informou a data nem se houve vítimas.
articles.summary: Vídeo divulgado nesta terça-feira atribui o ataque a Israel e aos Estados Unidos. Imprensa iraniana não informou a data nem se houve vítimas.
articles.body:
Adicione o g1 como Fonte Preferida no Google

Imagens divulgadas nesta terça-feira (24) pela imprensa iraniana mostram o que seria um ataque contra um avião comercial no início da guerra entre Irã , Estados Unidos e Israel. Veja acima.

Veículos de comunicação do Irã atribuíram o ataque a forças americanas e israelenses e afirmaram que a aeronave estava no aeroporto de Bushehr, cidade no sudoeste do país, na costa do Golfo Pérsico.

As publicações não especificaram quando o ataque teria ocorrido. Também não informaram se pessoas morreram ou ficaram feridas.

No início de março, a agência iraniana Mehr já havia noticiado um ataque contra uma aeronave da Iran Air no mesmo aeroporto. À época, a agência informou que um avião Airbus havia sido completamente destruído após ser atingido por um projétil.

A empresa também divulgou imagens da aeronave destruída e criticou o ataque em uma rede social.

Sites especializados em aviação identificaram o avião como um Airbus A319 da Iran Air, de matrícula EP-IEP. A aeronave estava estacionada no aeroporto quando foi atingida. Não houve informações sobre vítimas.

Na época do suposto ataque, o espaço aéreo iraniano estava fechado para voos civis, em meio à escalada dos ataques na região. A restrição havia sido prorrogada até pelo menos 3 de março.

Imagens de satélite divulgadas em março também mostram uma aeronave destruída no aeroporto de Bushehr. O registro, feito em 7 de março pela empresa Vantor, mostra danos na área de estacionamento de aviões.

Nas imagens, assim como no vídeo divulgado agora e em outros registros do ataque, a cauda aparece como uma das partes restantes da aeronave.

articles.title: São Sebastião lança material de alfabetização inspirado na cultura local  | G1
articles.standfirst: Material utiliza elementos da história, geografia, biodiversidade e cultura caiçara como recursos para o ensino da leitura e da escrita
articles.summary: Material utiliza elementos da história, geografia, biodiversidade e cultura caiçara como recursos para o ensino da leitura e da escrita
articles.body:
A alfabetização ganha um novo ponto de partida em São Sebastião, o próprio território onde as crianças vivem. A Prefeitura, por meio da Secretaria da Educação (Seduc), lança o projeto institucional e pedagógico ‘Um Mergulho na Alfabetização’, acompanhado de materiais exclusivos para professores e estudantes dos 1º e 2º anos do Ensino Fundamental da rede municipal. A proposta utiliza referências do patrimônio natural, histórico, geográfico e cultural do município para tornar o processo de aprendizagem da leitura e da escrita mais próximo da realidade dos alunos.

Adicione o g1 como Fonte Preferida no Google

As apostilas incorporam elementos presentes no cotidiano sebastianense, como praias, manguezais, biodiversidade da Mata Atlântica, lendas tradicionais e manifestações da cultura caiçara. Entre as propostas estão atividades que exploram os nomes das praias do município em ordem alfabética, o ecossistema do Manguezal do Araçá e narrativas populares, como as lendas do Pontal da Cruz e do Lobisomem de Boiçucanga. Dessa forma, o conhecimento sobre a cidade também se transforma em oportunidade para ampliar o repertório de palavras, desenvolver habilidades linguísticas e despertar o interesse pela leitura.

O material foi estruturado a partir de diferentes referências teóricas da alfabetização e do letramento. A proposta considera as hipóteses de escrita das crianças, os conhecimentos que elas já possuem e a importância da interação e da mediação docente durante a aprendizagem. Também incorpora estratégias de leitura e atividades que favorecem a construção de novos conhecimentos a partir das experiências e vivências dos estudantes.

Além das sequências didáticas, as apostilas oferecem jogos e recursos lúdicos, como Bingo das Letras, Bingo da Aliteração, Trilha da Rima, Dominó da Alfabetização e quebra-cabeças. As atividades trabalham habilidades importantes para o processo de alfabetização, especialmente a consciência fonológica, o reconhecimento das relações entre sons e letras e o desenvolvimento da leitura e da escrita.

Com foco na alfabetização dos estudantes na idade adequada, o projeto integra as estratégias da Seduc para assegurar o direito à aprendizagem nos primeiros anos do Ensino Fundamental. A iniciativa também dialoga com as diretrizes do programa estadual ‘Alfabetiza Juntos SP’ e do ‘Compromisso Nacional Criança Alfabetizada’, fortalecendo o trabalho pedagógico e valorizando a identidade local como parte da formação das crianças.

#PraTodosVerem: As imagens retratam um material de apoio educacional voltado para a alfabetização intitulado "Um Mergulho na Alfabetização", mostrando exemplares da cartilha ilustrados com temas marinhos e logotipos institucionais dispostos sobre a areia da praia e rochas à beira do mar, além de páginas abertas exibindo exercícios interativos, caça-palavras e atividades pedagógicas. Fim da descrição.

articles.title: Falta de água em João Pessoa: bairros desabastecidos na quarta (25) | G1
articles.standfirst: De acordo com a Cagepa, abastecimento será interrompido por "serviços de melhoria no sistema de distribuição de água", que atende os bairros de Mangabeira, Jardim Cidade Universitária e Bancários.
articles.summary: A falta de água em João Pessoa afeta Mangabeira, Bancários e Cidade Universitária nesta quarta-feira (25) durante obras de modernização da rede pela Cagepa.
articles.body:
Cerca de 96 mil moradores de três bairros de João Pessoa terão abastecimento de água interrompido nesta quarta (25) — Foto: Divulgação

Adicione o g1 como Fonte Preferida no Google

Cerca de 96 mil moradores de três bairros de João Pessoa terão o abastecimento de água interrompido nesta quarta-feira (25), de acordo com a Companhia de Água e Esgotos da Paraíba (Cagepa). O desabastecimento acontece das 7h às 20h .

Conforme a companhia, a interrupção acontece para que sejam feitos "serviços de melhoria no sistema de distribuição de água" nos bairros e consiste na implantação de um Sistema de Injeção Direta na Rede, no reservatório elevado R7.

O gerente regional da Cagepa no Litoral, Tiago Gama, explicou que a obra vai permitir um gerenciamento mais eficiente da distribuição de água, especialmente nos horários de maior consumo.

“Essa melhoria vai permitir um controle mais preciso da vazão e da pressão da água nas redes de distribuição, equilibrando o abastecimento mesmo nos períodos de maior demanda. Outro benefício importante será a redução do tempo necessário para restabelecer o fornecimento após paralisações operacionais, como serviços de manutenção e limpeza de reservatórios”, explicou.

A expectativa é que, após a reforma, a rede pode recuperar a pressão e a vazão de forma mais rápida após interrupções, reduzindo o período de desabastecimento e melhorando a regularidade do serviço prestado à população.

articles.summary: O prêmio para o ganhador da edição desta terça-feira era de R$ 65,9 milhões.
articles.body:

O sorteio do concurso 3.090 da Mega-Sena foi realizado na noite desta terça-feira (24), em São Paulo. O prêmio para as apostas que acertassem as seis dezenas era de R$ 65,9 milhões . No entanto, ninguém levou a faixa principal e o valor acumulou para R$ 75 milhões .

Veja os números sorteados: 10 - 14 - 27 - 28 - 47 - 57

5 acertos: 41 apostas ganhadoras, R$ 38.160,32

4 acertos: 3.800 apostas ganhadoras, R$ 588,18

O g1 passou a transmitir, desde abril, todos os sorteios das Loterias Caixa, ao vivo . A transmissão começa momentos antes de cada dia de concursos, no site e no canal do g1 no YouTube .

Resultado do concurso 3090 da Mega-Sena. — Foto: Reprodução/Caixa

A aposta mínima custa R$ 6 e pode ser realizada também pela internet, até as 20h – saiba como fazer a sua aposta online .

Os jogos podem ser realizados até as 20h (horário de Brasília) em qualquer lotérica do país ou por meio do site e aplicativo Loterias Caixa, disponíveis em smartphones, computadores e outros dispositivos.

Já os bolões digitais poderão ser comprados até as 20h30, exclusivamente pelo portal Loterias Online e pelo aplicativo.

O pagamento da aposta online pode ser realizado via PIX, cartão de crédito ou pelo internet banking, para correntistas da Caixa. É preciso ter 18 anos ou mais para participar.

A Mega tem três sorteios semanais: às terças, quintas e domingos .

A probabilidade de vencer em cada concurso varia de acordo com o número de dezenas jogadas e o tipo de aposta realizada. Para um jogo simples, com apenas seis dezenas, que custa R$ 6, a probabilidade de ganhar o prêmio milionário é de 1 em 50.063.860, segundo a Caixa.

Já para uma aposta com 20 dezenas (limite máximo), com o preço de R$ 232.560,00, a probabilidade de acertar o prêmio é de 1 em 1.292, ainda de acordo com a instituição.

articles.title: Adolfo Lutz não detecta parasita em novas amostras de água em Itapeva | G1
articles.standfirst: Especialista diz que instalação de ultrafiltração contribuiu para a remoção do parasita. Os casos de gastroenterite caíram no município. Sabesp afirma que a população pode voltar a consumir a água.
articles.summary: Após a instalação de novos filtros pela Sabesp e queda nos casos de virose, a água em Itapeva foi liberada para consumo após testes negativos para parasita.
articles.body:
Adicione o g1 como Fonte Preferida no Google

Novos exames realizados pelo Instituto Adolfo Lutz em amostras da água distribuída pela Sabesp em Itapeva (SP) não detectaram a presença do protozoário Cryptosporidium spp .. A informação foi confirmada à TV TEM nesta terça-feira (24).

Na segunda-feira (23), a Prefeitura de Itapeva revogou o decreto de calamidade pública , publicado em 6 de novembro, após a identificação do parasita na água distribuída à população. A cidade registrou mais de 5 mil casos de gastroenterite

🔎 O protozoário Cryptosporidium spp. afeta as células do intestino delgado e pode ser transmitido pela ingestão de água ou alimentos contaminados com fezes de humanos ou animais infectados. Ele causa diarréia intensa, cólicas, náuseas, vômitos e febre.

Estação de tratamento de água da Sabesp em Itapeva (SP) — Foto: TV TEM

A engenheira especialista em tratamento de água Angela Di Bernardo Dantas afirmou, em entrevista ao g1 e à TV TEM , que as amostras de água analisadas são coletadas desde 9 de novembro. Segundo ela, desde então, não foi detectada a presença do parasita.

"A ausência de detecção desse protozoário no sistema de abastecimento de água é resultado das medidas tomadas pela Sabesp ao longo desses últimos dias. A principal delas foi a implantação da unidade de ultrafiltração, uma tecnologia extremamente eficaz na remoção desses protozoários. Além disso, foram feitas descargas na rede e a limpeza de reservatórios", explicou.

Instituto Adolfo Lutz encontrou o protozoário Cryptosporidium spp. em quatro de dez amostras coletadas em Itapeva (SP) — Foto: TV TEM

Ainda segundo a especialista, estudos para identificar como o protozoário chegou aos mananciais de Itapeva ainda estão em andamento. Uma das hipóteses é que o grande volume de chuva registrado no município semanas antes tenha contribuído para a contaminação.

"Com certeza teve uma influência muito grande das chuvas intensas,que foram chuvas totalmente excepcionais que aconteceram no manancial. Estão sendo feitas pesquisas para entender a fonte. Mas, com certeza, tem a relação com a porte que veio junto com as chuvas", detalha.

A Sabesp informou que a população pode voltar a utilizar a água, tanto para consumo, quanto para outras atividades.

"A Sabesp já fez a limpeza dos reservatórios conforme as normas e literatura técnica, executou as descargas na rede de distribuição também para limpar as adutoras, para tirar qualquer tipo de biofilme, e está fornecendo, desde o dia 9 de novembro uma água ultrafiltrada", afirmou a especialista.

O número de casos de gastroenterite, popularmente conhecida como virose, apresenta queda desde 25 de outubro em Itapeva (SP). O pico de registros foi entre os dias 4 e 10 de outubro, quando foram contabilizados 1.426 casos.

De acordo com o boletim epidemiológico divulgado pela prefeitura nesta terça-feira, entre 8 e 21 de novembro, foram registrados 662 casos da doença.

articles.title: Árvore cai em escola e deixa 5 crianças feridas na Zona Leste de SP | G1
articles.standfirst: Segundo o Corpo de Bombeiros, as crianças foram socorridas por meios próprios. Outros quatro tiveram ferimentos leves e um sofreu uma fratura.
articles.summary: Segundo o Corpo de Bombeiros, as crianças foram socorridas por meios próprios. Outros quatro tiveram ferimentos leves e um sofreu uma fratura.
articles.body:
Adicione o g1 como Fonte Preferida no Google

Uma queda de árvore no pátio da Escola Estadual Professora Maria da Conceição Oliveira Costa na Rua Lagoa Taí Grande, em Itaquera, na Zona Leste de São Paulo, deixou cinco crianças feridas na tarde desta terça-feira (24). Segundo o Corpo de Bombeiros, quatro tiveram ferimentos leves e uma sofreu fratura.

Segundo as informações do atendimento, todas as vítimas estavam conscientes. Cinco viaturas foram mobilizadas para a ocorrência, registrada às 15h08.

No muro da escola havia uma placa alertando para o risco de queda de árvores no entorno.

Portão da escola estadual Escola Municipal Professora Maria da Conceição Oliveira Costa, onde árvore caiu e deixou sete feridos. — Foto: Reprodução/TV Globo

Por volta das 17h30, a entrada da escola estava tomada por pais preocupados em busca de notícias sobre os filhos. A enfermeira Elaine Simone soube da queda da árvore por uma publicação no status do WhatsApp e correu para a unidade, sem saber se a filha havia se machucado.

"Eu vi pelo status do WhatsApp e vim correndo, sem saber quem tinha se machucado. Mas, graças a Deus, está tudo bem. Minha filha está bem", contou.

Em nota, a Secretaria da Educação do Estado de São Paulo (Seduc-SP) informou que "a equipe gestora prestou os primeiros atendimentos a cinco alunos e acionou o Serviço de Atendimento Móvel de Urgência (Samu) imediatamente após o ocorrido. Três alunos foram encaminhados ao hospital, acompanhados de um funcionário. Os responsáveis foram acionados e acompanharam os estudantes, que passaram por avaliação médica e seguem em observação. Outros dois alunos que estavam próximo da árvore não se feriram".

Ainda segundo a secretaria, as aulas seguem normalmente. Além disso, equipes da Fundação para o Desenvolvimento da Educação (FDE) e da prefeitura trabalham na retirada dos galhos e das partes da árvore que caíram na escola.

Vento provoca queda de árvore na Zona Leste nesta terça (24). — Foto: Reprodução/TV Globo

A cidade de São Paulo entrou em estado de atenção para alagamentos em todas as regiões às 16h20 desta terça-feira (24), segundo o Centro de Gerenciamento de Emergências Climáticas (CGE), da Prefeitura. O alerta foi encerrado às 17h30.

O aviso incluia as zonas Norte, Sul, Leste e Oeste, além do Centro e das marginais Tietê e Pinheiros.

Segundo o CGE, havia potencial elevado de alagamentos, enxurradas repentinas e rajadas de vento que podem superar os 60 km/h.

De acordo com imagens do radar meteorológico do CGE, há registro de chuva moderada nas zonas Norte e Oeste, principalmente nas subprefeituras de Freguesia do Ó, Casa Verde e Lapa.

As áreas de instabilidade vêm do interior do estado e atuam de forma isolada, mas apresentam tendência de se espalhar por toda a capital. O deslocamento das chuvas ocorre no sentido de Norte para Sul.

A previsão é a de que as precipitações continuem até boa parte da noite.

Vento provoca queda de árvore na Zona Leste nesta terça (24). — Foto: Abraão Cruz/TV Globo

Cidade de SP entra em estado de atenção para alagamentos nesta terça-feira (24) — Foto: Reprodução

Também não estão descartadas ocorrências de granizo e transbordamentos de rios e córregos na capital paulista e na Região Metropolitana de São Paulo.

A recomendação é que os moradores evitem áreas alagadas, não tentem atravessar ruas inundadas e redobrem a atenção durante as pancadas de chuva.

articles.title: Câmara do Rio entrega medalhas a Pavanato e Campopiano após polêmica | G1
articles.standfirst: Eduarda Campopiano receberá a Medalha Chiquinha Gonzaga, e Lucas Pavanato, o Conjunto de Medalhas de Mérito Pedro Ernesto. A cerimônia foi antecipada após relatos de possíveis hostilidades.
articles.summary: Eduarda Campopiano receberá a Medalha Chiquinha Gonzaga, e Lucas Pavanato, o Conjunto de Medalhas de Mérito Pedro Ernesto; cerimônia foi antecipada.
articles.body:
Alana Passos (PL), Campopiano (PL-SP), Pavanato (PL-SP), Fernando Armelau (PL). — Foto: André Coelho Costa / TV Globo

Adicione o g1 como Fonte Preferida no Google

A Câmara Municipal do Rio homenageou nesta terça-feira (24) os deputados eleitos Eduarda Campopiano (PL-SP) e Lucas Pavanato (PL-SP), após semanas de polêmica e tentativas de suspender as medalhas.

Campopiano recebeu a Medalha de Reconhecimento Chiquinha Gonzaga, enquanto Pavanato será agraciado com o Conjunto de Medalhas de Mérito Pedro Ernesto, a maior honraria do Legislativo carioca.

A entrega ocorre em meio à repercussão nacional da concessão das medalhas. No caso de Campopiano, uma petição contrária à homenagem reuniu mais de 500 mil assinaturas , e vereadores, entidades e representantes da sociedade civil apresentaram questionamentos para tentar impedir a cerimônia.

A solenidade estava inicialmente prevista para 3 de dezembro, mas foi antecipada a pedido do vereador Fernando Armelau (PL), responsável por solicitar a realização do evento.

Segundo o gabinete do parlamentar, a mudança ocorreu após relatos de possíveis hostilidades contra os homenageados , incluindo ameaças de arremesso de ovos. A antecipação, de acordo com a equipe do vereador, busca preservar a segurança dos participantes.

Durante a solenidade, Campopiano se colocou contra o movimento feminista e relembrou sua votação histórica em São Paulo.

"O movimento feminista tentou arrogar para si todos os méritos com relação a tudo que diz respeito a qualquer tipo de mulher. Eu entendo a frustração das feministas, eu entendo a frustração da militância. Em São Paulo, eu sozinha fiz mais votos do que toda a bancada feminista somada. Aqui no Rio fiz mais votos do que todas as deputadas feministas, se for comparar", comentou a homenageada.

Após pedidos de cancelamento, Câmara do Rio antecipa entrega de medalhas a Campopiano e Pavanato — Foto: Reprodução

Ao receber a medalha, Eduarda Campopiano criticou as manifestações contrárias à homenagem e contestou a associação entre o legado de Chiquinha Gonzaga e o movimento feminista. A deputada estadual eleita afirmou que a compositora conquistou espaço por mérito próprio e não por influência de um movimento ideológico.

"Mais uma vez acharam que iam conseguir se apropriar de todas as vitórias. Falam de Chiquinha Gonzaga, como se Chiquinha Gonzaga estivesse sido uma militante feminista escandalosa gritando no meio da rua", disse Campopiano.

"Chiquinha Gonzaga foi uma guerreira de muita classe. Quando ela realizou seus feitos sequer existia feminismo no Brasil. (...) Chiquinha Gonzaga foi uma mulher que lutou e conquistou seus espaços pelo seu próprio mérito, pela própria força e sua própria coragem e não pelo movimento coletivista ideológico de extrema-esquerda", completou.

A concessão da Medalha Chiquinha Gonzaga a Eduarda Campopiano foi aprovada pela Câmara em 10 de novembro. A deputada estadual eleita por São Paulo tem 23 anos e recebeu quase 2 milhões de votos nas eleições.

Eduarda Campopiano e Fernando Armelau durante homenagem — Foto: Reprodução

A homenagem provocou críticas por causa de declarações públicas da parlamentar contra o movimento feminista . Em suas redes sociais, Campopiano se apresenta como a “maior inimiga das feministas de São Paulo”. Em outra publicação, afirmou: “Se antes eu já suspeitava, agora tenho plena certeza. Não devo nada ao feminismo. Nenhuma mulher deve.”

A petição contrária à homenagem foi criada pela advogada Jessica Acocella. O texto argumenta que a concessão da medalha seria incompatível com o legado de Chiquinha Gonzaga, compositora e maestrina carioca que dá nome à honraria.

A Medalha Chiquinha Gonzaga foi criada em 1999 e é destinada a mulheres que se destacam em causas democráticas, humanitárias, artísticas e culturais. Entre as personalidades que já receberam a homenagem estão Maria Bethânia e Tia Surica.

Câmara rejeitou pedido para cancelar homenagem

A vereadora Monica Benicio (PSOL) apresentou um requerimento para suspender a entrega da medalha a Campopiano . A Presidência da Câmara, porém, rejeitou o pedido.

Na decisão, assinada pela presidente em exercício da Casa, Tânia Bastos, a justificativa foi que o requerimento não se enquadrava nas hipóteses previstas pelo Regimento Interno para suspender uma honraria já concedida.

A presidência também entendeu que os critérios da homenagem deveriam ter sido questionados antes da votação.

Monica apresentou um novo recurso para tentar levar o tema ao plenário. A vereadora argumentou que a atuação pública de Campopiano seria incompatível com a finalidade da medalha.

O Instituto dos Advogados Brasileiros e a OAB Mulher também questionaram a concessão da honraria. Os pedidos foram apresentados à Câmara, mas, segundo informações divulgadas pela Casa, ainda aguardavam apreciação.

A polêmica também motivou a vereadora Tatiana Roque (PSB) a propor mudanças nas regras de concessão das medalhas Chiquinha Gonzaga e Pedro Ernesto . A proposta busca estabelecer restrições para homenagear pessoas que façam apologia ou incitação a formas de violência física ou psicológica.

Pavanato recebe a maior honraria da Câmara — Foto: Reprodução

Pavanato recebe a maior honraria da Câmara

Além de Campopiano, a Câmara Municipal do Rio aprovou a concessão do Conjunto de Medalhas de Mérito Pedro Ernesto a Lucas Pavanato, deputado federal eleito por São Paulo pelo PL.

A Medalha Pedro Ernesto é considerada a maior honraria do Legislativo carioca. A cerimônia desta terça-feira reunirá os dois políticos na sede da Câmara, no Palácio Pedro Ernesto, na Cinelândia, no Centro do Rio.

A entrega foi solicitada pelo vereador Fernando Armelau (PL). Segundo o gabinete do parlamentar, a antecipação da cerimônia ocorreu após relatos de possíveis hostilidades contra os homenageados.

Em nota, a Câmara Municipal do Rio de Janeiro informou que, "uma vez reservado o plenário para a realização de solenidade de entrega de honrarias, cabe ao vereador responsável pelo evento a definição dos homenageados, bem como eventuais alterações na programação".

articles.title: Após voltar ao comando da Nvidia, Jensen Huang pede desculpas por traição e diz fazer terapia | G1
articles.standfirst: Jensen Huang reconheceu ter violado regras que ajudou a elaborar e negou que tenha retornado ao cargo por pressão de Donald Trump; ações da empresa caíram mais de 7%.
articles.summary: Jensen Huang reconheceu ter violado regras que ajudou a elaborar e negou que tenha retornado ao cargo por pressão de Donald Trump; ações da empresa caíram mais de 7%.
articles.body:
Jensen Huang, CEO da Nvidia. — Foto: Evelyn Hockstein/Reuters

Adicione o g1 como Fonte Preferida no Google

O CEO da Nvidia , Jensen Huang , pediu desculpas nesta terça-feira (24) aos funcionários por ter violado o código de conduta da empresa e afirmou que está fazendo terapia .

A declaração ocorreu um dia após o conselho de administração aprovar seu retorno ao comando da companhia, segundo informações da imprensa americana.

"Cometi erros terríveis", disse Huang durante uma reunião de uma hora com funcionários na sede da Nvidia , em Santa Clara, na Califórnia, informou o The New York Times, após analisar a transmissão do encontro.

"Fui infiel a Lori e magoei meus filhos e, é claro, magoei todos vocês", afirmou, em referência à esposa, com quem está casado há mais de 40 anos.

Huang, que cofundou a Nvidia , havia renunciado ao cargo em 11 de novembro , após a revelação de relacionamentos extraconjugais .

Um deles teria sido com uma funcionária da empresa. O outro, com Alice Huang, executiva de uma companhia cliente da Nvidia , que, segundo autoridades americanas, é suspeita de atuar como agente da inteligência chinesa.

Na reunião, um dia após a aprovação de seu retorno pelo conselho, Huang reconheceu que não era "aceitável" ter descumprido um código de conduta cuja elaboração ele próprio ajudou a liderar, de acordo com o Times.

O executivo também negou que tenha voltado ao cargo por pressão do presidente dos Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, sobre o conselho de administração. Segundo Huang, os conselheiros investigaram os fatos e receberam garantias do governo americano de que ele não representava uma ameaça à segurança nacional.

Trump, no entanto, afirmou à CNBC na segunda-feira que conversou com o conselho sobre o retorno do executivo. "Conversei com eles, digamos assim", disse. "E os convenci."

O The Wall Street Journal, citando pessoas familiarizadas com o assunto, informou que Huang agradeceu ao governo americano por ter dado à Nvidia acesso rápido a informações de inteligência. Segundo o jornal, esses dados ajudaram o conselho a decidir pela recondução do executivo.

Ainda de acordo com o Journal, Huang afirmou que, a partir de agora, os funcionários que se reportam diretamente a ele enviarão ao conselho avaliações sobre seu comportamento.

O CEO também rejeitou relatos de que seria um chefe abusivo e negou exercer um controle excessivamente centralizado sobre a Nvidia , empresa que fundou há cerca de três décadas.

As ações da Nvidia fecharam em queda de 5,86% nas negociações desta terça-feira.

A empresa não respondeu imediatamente a um pedido de comentário da AFP.

articles.title: Ex-contadora é condenada por desviar R$ 248 mil de posto em MT | G1
articles.standfirst: Fraudes envolveram alterações em registros de fretes, cheques em nome de familiares e retenção de aluguéis de estabelecimentos comerciais.
articles.summary: Fraudes envolveram alterações em registros de fretes, cheques em nome de familiares e retenção de aluguéis de estabelecimentos comerciais.
articles.body:
Foto de posto de gasolina. — Foto: Marcello Casal Jr./Agência Brasil

Adicione o g1 como Fonte Preferida no Google

Uma ex-contadora de um posto de combustíveis foi condenada pela Justiça do Trabalho a ressarcir R$ 248 mil por desviar dinheiro da empresa em Confresa , a 1.160 km de Cuiabá. Segundo a decisão, as fraudes ocorreram entre agosto de 2024 e agosto de 2025 e envolveram alterações em registros de fretes, créditos fictícios, cheques emitidos em nome de familiares e retenção de valores de aluguéis.

A decisão é da juíza Rosiane Cardoso , da Vara do Trabalho de Confresa. A magistrada considerou que documentos, depoimentos e informações de uma investigação policial comprovaram a participação da ex-funcionária nos desvios.

As irregularidades foram identificadas cerca de um mês depois de a trabalhadora pedir demissão, em outubro de 2025. Na ocasião, o gerente-geral encontrou um crédito de quase R$ 5 mil lançado indevidamente em favor de uma empresa cliente que tinha dívidas antigas com o posto.

A partir da inconsistência, a administração iniciou uma investigação interna e identificou alterações retroativas nos registros de fretes, créditos fictícios utilizados para quitar faturas e cheques desviados. Também foram constatadas irregularidades no recebimento de aluguéis de estabelecimentos comerciais instalados no local.

De acordo com a investigação policial, cheques recebidos de clientes e cheques-troco emitidos pelo próprio posto eram preenchidos em nome de familiares da ex-contadora. Em depoimentos, a mãe e as sobrinhas dela disseram desconhecer a emissão dos documentos e afirmaram que não receberam os valores.

A investigação também apontou que a ex-funcionária retinha parte dos pagamentos de aluguéis feitos pelos comerciantes que mantinham estabelecimentos no posto. Em um dos casos, um locatário comprovou ter pago R$ 8,6 mil em cheques entregues à contadora, mas apenas metade do valor foi repassada à administração.

Durante o processo, a ex-empregada negou ter cometido as fraudes e alegou que não havia provas de sua participação. Ela também questionou os registros de acesso ao sistema, que estavam vinculados ao login de outra funcionária, e afirmou que os controles internos da empresa apresentavam falhas.

A defesa ainda contestou um documento manuscrito em que a trabalhadora reconheceu uma dívida de R$ 250 mil. Segundo ela, o documento foi assinado sob coação, após uma abordagem dos proprietários do posto, acompanhados de familiares e seguranças armados, em sua loja comercial. Ela afirmou que foi pressionada a entregar as chaves de um carro e de uma motocicleta, além de fazer um Pix de R$ 2,5 mil.

A juíza, no entanto, entendeu que as demais provas comprovaram a participação da ex-contadora nos desvios. Uma funcionária cujo login foi utilizado nos lançamentos afirmou que não tinha atribuições relacionadas ao faturamento e que estava afastada em licença-maternidade quando as irregularidades começaram.

Além disso, durante a investigação policial, a ex-empregada admitiu ter utilizado as credenciais da colega para realizar baixas e estornos. Também reconheceu que recebia cheques e aluguéis dos comerciantes, mas retinha parte dos valores e depositava cheques emitidos em nome de familiares em contas próprias.

A magistrada considerou que as declarações prestadas à polícia estavam de acordo com as demais provas documentais e contábeis, mesmo após a ex-funcionária voltar atrás em juízo.

Sobre a alegação de coação na assinatura do documento de reconhecimento da dívida, testemunhas relataram que não houve ameaças ou agressões durante a conversa. Segundo os depoimentos, a própria trabalhadora teria proposto formas de ressarcimento, incluindo a entrega de um carro e uma motocicleta e o pagamento parcelado.

A juíza ressaltou que a condenação não foi baseada no documento de reconhecimento da dívida, mas na comprovação dos prejuízos causados à empresa durante o contrato de trabalho.

Ao final, a magistrada reconheceu a prática de ato ilícito doloso e a responsabilidade da ex-funcionária pelos danos financeiros. Além dos R$ 248 mil de ressarcimento, ela também deverá pagar honorários advocatícios.

articles.title: Expectativa de vida em Cuba cai pela primeira vez em quase 80 anos | G1
articles.standfirst: Indicador passou de 78,8 anos em 2020 para 74,4 anos em 2025. Mortalidade infantil mais que dobrou no período, segundo a organização.
articles.summary: Indicador passou de 78,8 anos em 2020 para 74,4 anos em 2025. Mortalidade infantil mais que dobrou no período, segundo a organização.
articles.body:
Muitos exilados cubanos nos EUA desejam a queda do regime em Cuba para poder voltar ao país — Foto: Carl Juste/Miami Herald/ZUMA/picture alliance

Adicione o g1 como Fonte Preferida no Google

A expectativa de vida diminuiu pela primeira vez em quase 80 anos em Cuba , com uma queda superior a quatro anos entre 2020 e 2025, informou nesta terça-feira (24) o diretor-geral da Organização Mundial da Saúde ( OMS ), Tedros Adhanom.

A ilha, que tem quase 9,5 milhões de habitantes, enfrenta há bastante tempo uma grave crise econômica, que se aprofundou com o bloqueio energético imposto pelos Estados Unidos no início deste ano.

"A mortalidade aumentou e a expectativa de vida em Cuba diminuiu pela primeira vez desde que os registros começaram a ser feitos, em 1950, passando de 78,8 anos em 2020 para 74,4 anos em 2025", afirmou Adhanom, em entrevista coletiva.

O sistema de saúde de Cuba , reconhecido internacionalmente, foi durante décadas uma das principais conquistas do governo comunista, mas agora "está atravessando uma situação difícil e crítica", acrescentou Ghebreyesus, ao fim de uma visita de três dias à ilha.

Segundo o diretor da OMS , a taxa de mortalidade infantil "mais do que dobrou", passando de quatro mortes por mil nascidos vivos em 2020 para 9,9 em 2025.

Da mesma forma, a mortalidade materna passou de 37,4 por mil nascidos vivos em 2019 para 44,1 em 2025.

"A taxa de sobrevivência ao câncer pediátrico caiu de 85% para 65% após o início do bloqueio energético" imposto pelos Estados Unidos, acrescentou.

articles.title: Iran flogs female singer 74 times for performing without hijab in viral YouTube concert
articles.summary: Lawyers said singer Parastoo Ahmadi and members of her concert team received 74 lashes each in Qom after performing without a hijab. They also face two-year bans.
articles.body: Iranian authorities subjected a female singer and four members of her concert team to 74 lashes each Monday after she defied the Islamic Republic’s restrictions on women by performing without a hijab in a viral YouTube concert, their lawyers said. Parastoo Ahmadi, 29, and her four male co-defendants were flogged in the Iranian city of Qom, defense attorney Mostafa Nili told Iranian news outlet Emtedad, according to Reuters. The five were also banned from traveling abroad and engaging in artistic and musical activities for two years. IRAN'S REGIME CAME FOR TEENAGE TWINS. THEIR FATE OFFERS A GLIMPSE OF TEHRAN'S WIDENING DEATH CAMPAIGN One of the defendants’ lawyers told the BBC Monday that efforts to overturn the ruling, reduce the punishment or suspend its enforcement had failed. Defense attorneys also sought to postpone the flogging, but authorities insisted on carrying out the sentence immediately. The punishment sparked outrage among Iranian artists and human rights advocates, who condemned the regime’s restrictions on women and artistic expression. Bahar Ghandehari, director of advocacy at the U.S.-based Center for Human Rights in Iran (CHRI), told the BBC that Ahmadi’s flogging was "a flagrant violation of her fundamental rights" and demonstrated the authorities’ determination to suppress women’s freedoms and punish those who challenge discriminatory laws. Those flogged alongside Ahmadi were musicians Soheil Faghih-Nasiri, Amin Taheri and Amirali Pirnia and producer Mohsen Lashkari. IRAN REGIME'S EXECUTION SPREE CONTINUES AS TWINS FACE DEATH PENALTY, DECADES IN PRISON AFTER ALLEGED TORTURE The case stems from a Dec. 11, 2024, performance in which Ahmadi appeared in a sleeveless black dress with her hair uncovered, accompanied by male musicians at the historic Deir Gachin Caravanserai in Qom province. With no audience physically present, Ahmadi shared the performance, known as the "Imaginary Concert," on her YouTube channel. The video of the concert has garnered over 3 million views on YouTube. Iran’s judiciary swiftly opened a criminal case over the performance, and Ahmadi was arrested three days later. Two musicians involved in the concert were also arrested. All three were subsequently released on bail, according to the Norway-based Hengaw Organization for Human Rights. In June 2026, a criminal court in Qom sentenced Ahmadi and eight others involved in the production to 74 lashes each on charges of "offending public decency by producing and publishing obscene and immoral content online," according to Hengaw. The defendants denied the charges. An appeals court upheld the flogging sentences in September, clearing the way for their enforcement, Iran International reported Sept. 25. IRAN JAILS PSYCHOLOGIST OVER TRUMP PLEA AS REGIME DEMANDS HE MAKE AMERICANS ‘LOOK STUPID’: FAMILY Amnesty International urged Iranian authorities in October to abandon plans to carry out the sentences, arguing that judicial flogging amounts to torture and violates international human rights protections. Ahmadi, a native of Nowshahr in northern Iran who studied film directing at Soore University, had previously faced restrictions from Iranian security authorities over her performances of protest songs and regional folk music during the Woman, Life, Freedom movement, according to Hengaw. The movement erupted in September 2022 following the death in custody of Mahsa Amini, a 22-year-old Iranian Kurdish woman detained by the country’s morality police for allegedly violating mandatory hijab rules. Many Iranian women have since openly defied the compulsory dress code, despite periodic arrests, warnings and other enforcement measures. Of the nine people originally sentenced over Ahmadi’s concert, five were reported to have been flogged Monday. The status of the remaining defendants’ punishments remains unclear. Ahmadi’s punishment comes amid a broader human rights crackdown in Iran that has intensified since nationwide anti-regime protests erupted in January. In addition to years of restrictions on women, artists, journalists and political dissidents, Iranian authorities have increasingly resorted to mass arrests, torture in detention and executions to suppress opposition, as previously reported by Fox News Digital. Human Rights Watch reported in February that Iran’s executions in 2025 had reached levels unseen since the late 1980s, while rights groups have documented a further escalation in political repression throughout 2026. Earlier this month, the Norway-based Iran Human Rights organization reported that at least 121 people arrested in connection with January’s protests had been sentenced to death, including at least 30 whose sentences had been upheld by Iran’s Supreme Court. CLICK HERE TO DOWNLOAD THE FOX NEWS APP Iranian authorities did not immediately respond to Fox News Digital's request for comment. Reuters contributed to this report.

articles.title: Reform bid to oust presiding officer fails after its Senedd boycott ends
articles.summary: Senedd members reject Reform's motion to oust Huw Irranca Davies by 55 votes to 29.
articles.body:
An attempt by Reform UK to remove the Senedd's Presiding Officer has failed, following a passionate speech to the Welsh Parliament by Huw Irranca-Davies.

Members of the Senedd (MSs) rejected Reform's motion by 55 votes to 29.

Earlier the party ended a two-week boycott of most proceedings in the chamber after one of them, Joe Martin, was banned from speaking and told to apologise for remarks about immigration.

Irranca-Davies, whose title is Llywydd, said his duty was to "apply the rules fairly and impartially".

Reform's Llyr Powell said: "If you had a problem with what Joe Martin said, debate him, don't shut him down."

A source close to Irranca-Davies had "wholly refuted" Reform's accusations he had changed his mind during negotiations about Martin returning to the debating chamber.

Irranca-Davies had ruled that a claim by Martin - that white people were being "replaced" - broke the rules because it was "unnecessarily provocative and deliberately offensive".

Responding to Reform's attempt to remove him on Tuesday evening, the presiding office gave a long and passionate speech in defence of his role, which prompted a standing ovation from the other Cardiff Bay parties.

"The duty of the chair is not to please, it is not to flatter, not to avoid controversy, it is to apply the rules fairly and impartially, irrespective of pressure, of popularity or of political consequence," he said.

"Parliamentary privilege has never meant that anything goes, it has never meant speech without standards, it has never meant rights without responsibilities.

"Without rules, eventually it is only the loudest voices that are heard. "Without rules intimidation begins to replace persuasion, without rules scrutiny deteriorates into shouting."

After losing the vote, which Reform had no realistic prospect of winning, its Welsh leader Helen Jenner said it was "now clear that the establishment parties are content to see a Member of this Senedd silenced".

"We will continue to fight for the rights of elected members to represent their constituents as they see fit," she said.

At the start of the afternoon session, without announcing an end to their protest, Reform MSs walked into the debating chamber together ahead of First Minister's Questions on Tuesday afternoon . Martin was not among them.

Jenner began her contribution by asking Senedd members: "Did you miss us?"

"It's been a little bit duller without us in here," she added.

In an answer to a question from her, First Minister Rhun ap Iorwerth said "it's good of her to turn up today", and later accused her party of "chucking their toys out of the pram".

Reform is the biggest opposition group in the Senedd, but its members have stayed away from plenary sessions - full meetings in the debating chamber - since 11 November.

The party said it had left its seats empty during debates and questions to Welsh government ministers because it was standing up for free speech.

The boycott began after Irranca-Davies told Martin his comments had broken the Senedd's rules, and he would not be called to speak until he apologised.

Shortly after its members had returned to the Senedd chamber, the party sent journalists a statement from Jenner.

She said the party "thought we were approaching a sensible resolution" in talks with the Llywydd that would allow Martin "to return to the chamber without apologising for the speech he made in the Senedd".

"It has become clear this morning that the Llywydd has not been negotiating in good faith and has changed his mind at the eleventh hour," Jenner said.

"He has admitted to us that his decisions on this matter have been influenced by the feelings of outside organisations.

"It is now for him to explain to the people of Wales which organisations they are and what that means for Welsh democracy.

"We now have no choice but to escalate this situation."

The Senedd's authorities strongly denied Reform's "completely inaccurate" claims and said the Llywydd's position had remained the same since he ruled against Martin.

A source close to Irranca-Davies said he was "always clear" during four meetings with Reform that Martin needed to apologise.

Irranca-Davies, who chairs Senedd plenary sessions, left the chamber during First Minister's Questions on Tuesday afternoon.

A spokesperson for the Llywydd said he met Jenner "entirely in good faith and had hoped to continue these confidential discussions constructively".

"It is unfortunate that they have chosen this course of action," the spokesperson added.

"While the Llywydd is disappointed, he respects the democratic process.

"Just as members elected him to this role, it is right that they have the opportunity to decide whether he continue to have their confidence."

articles.title: Costs to skyrocket for tourists in major city as popular destination battles crowds
articles.summary: Amsterdam will raise its tourist tax from 12.5% to 20% by 2031, stacking on a 21% hotel VAT that could push total accommodation taxes to 41%. A travel expert shared perspective.
articles.body: Taking a trip to one of the world's most visited cities will soon be more expensive, as the destination prepares to implement one of the highest tourist taxes on the globe. With a goal of reducing tourism in Amsterdam, a new coalition there, PRO and D66, unveiled plans to gradually raise the tourist tax from its current rate of 12.5% to 20% in 2031, news outlet NOS (the Dutch Broadcasting Foundation) reported. The new rate will be tacked onto the previously increased value-added tax (VAT) on hotel stays, which the nation’s government introduced earlier this year. CRUISE FEE DOUBLES AT VACATION HOT SPOT AS PASSENGERS BRACE FOR EVEN STEEPER HIKES As of 2026, tourists visiting the Netherlands are charged a 21% VAT at hotels, more than double the previous 9% rate. Barcelona-based travel expert Jordi Lippe-McGraw told Fox News Digital there are pros and cons to the tax hikes. "It’s easy to forget that these aren’t just destinations, they’re people’s homes. Living in Barcelona, I see it every day," she said. "Locals deal with packed streets and rising rents, and some get priced out of neighborhoods their families have lived in for generations," said Lippe-McGraw. FURIOUS CROWDS PROTEST SKY-HIGH HOUSING COSTS AND MASS TOURISM IN MAJOR CITY "People need to be able to live comfortably in their own city. So I understand why places like Amsterdam and Barcelona are asking visitors to pay more." She said that "if the money really goes back into housing, cleaner streets and better services for residents, I think that’s fair." Lippe-McGraw said she's not convinced that higher hotel taxes will solve the tourism issue, however. "Someone who has dreamed of seeing Amsterdam for years isn’t going to cancel over a higher hotel bill," she said. "They’ll just book somewhere cheaper or stay outside the city and come in for the day." "If the money really goes back into housing, cleaner streets and better services for residents, I think that’s fair." "The ones who really get hurt are small hotels, restaurants and shops, plus budget travelers," she added. With the recently announced gradual tax increases in effect, tourists will pay a 41% VAT for accommodations by 2031. Amsterdam already has the steepest tourist tax in Europe, according to the Royal Dutch Hospitality Association (KHN). CLICK HERE TO SIGN UP FOR OUR LIFESTYLE NEWSLETTER By 2031, the tax will be one of the world’s highest, beaten out only by Bhutan, a country in South Asia. The higher tax rate on accommodations has hotel owners worried, and some have already seen a decrease in guests after the previous increase. "Our occupancy rate is still acceptable, but due to the combination of the increased tourist tax and the rise in VAT, we are now seeing a decline of approximately 10%," a manager of Hotel Het Hart van Weesp in Weesp, a municipality near Amsterdam, told NOS. Although Weesp is outside of Amsterdam proper, there will be no tax exemption granted. TEST YOURSELF WITH OUR LATEST LIFESTYLE QUIZ "Including commissions from major booking platforms, most bookings now include almost half of the accommodation price from taxes and commission. With a further increase in the tourist tax, this will even be well over half," the manager said. More than 22 million hotel stays were recorded in Amsterdam in 2025, according to Statistics Netherlands (CBS). Lippe-McGraw, for her part, said she's seeing overcrowding in many major cities in Europe. "This summer, Dubrovnik and Venice were both really crowded," she said. "In some spots you could barely move through the old towns, and you were constantly working your way around tour groups." articles.title: Alleged drunken driver was over 3 times the limit when he killed newly engaged woman days after jail release
articles.summary: Diego Arreola faces DUI manslaughter charges after police say he caused a fatal chain-reaction crash on Tampa's Courtney Campbell Causeway while drunk.
articles.body: Investigators say a suspect previously convicted of DUI was yet again driving drunk, more than three times the legal limit, when he caused a chain-reaction crash that killed a young woman just days after he was released from jail. Police say Diego Arreola, 30, of Saint Petersburg, Florida, was behind the wheel Friday evening when he rear-ended a vehicle and caused a multi-car crash on the Courtney Campbell Causeway in Tampa. Leanna Blaize Albertson-Czerwinski, 27, of Tarpon Springs, was killed as a result, investigators say. She was pronounced dead on scene and Arreola, who is currently in the hospital, faces a slew of charges. Albertson-Czerwinski appeared to be recently engaged, according to her social media. Arreola also violated probation and was not supposed to be driving in the first place, according to police. He had been released from jail on Nov. 16. Records show he had a blood alcohol content of 0.285 at the time of the crash, Tampa Bay 28 reported. articles.title: Ex- Ukraine prosecutor general accuses Zelenskyy's office of interfering in anti-corruption investigation
articles.summary: Former prosecutor general Ruslan Kravchenko alleges political interference, while Zelenskyy defended his removal and anti-corruption agencies rejected the accusations.
articles.body: Ukraine's former prosecutor general is accusing President Volodymyr Zelenskyy's administration of interfering in a criminal investigation involving the head of the country's anti-corruption bureau after the president demanded his removal from office in September. In an extensive interview with Fox News Digital, Ruslan Kravchenko alleged that Zelenskyy's decision to remove him came under pressure from the National Anti-Corruption Bureau of Ukraine (NABU) and the Specialized Anti-Corruption Prosecutor's Office (SAPO), whose officials he said his office had been investigating. "The signature on the resignation letter was mine. The decision was his," Kravchenko said. "You do not have to put handcuffs on the president himself to tie his hands. It is enough to put the people he relies on at risk." BILLIONS IN US AID TO UKRAINE UNDER MICROSCOPE AS CORRUPTION ROCKS ZELENSKYY’S INNER CIRCLE Kravchenko's most serious allegation concerns what happened afterward. He claims the president's office instructed prosecutors to close a criminal case involving NABU Director Semen Kryvonos. "The Office of the President began issuing instructions to the Office of the Prosecutor General to immediately close the criminal case against the head of NABU," he said. "In my assessment, that amounts to deliberate interference in an investigation." "The authority to investigate crimes becomes the ability to determine government policy and even geopolitics," he argued. Kravchenko did not identify who allegedly issued those instructions or provide documentary evidence of the communications in the materials supplied to Fox News Digital. His allegation of presidential interference has not been independently verified. UKRAINE'S ZELENSKYY ON DEFYING US IN ATTACKING RUSSIAN OIL: 'OUR RESPONSE MUST BE PAINFUL' The dispute behind his removal Kravchenko's departure followed a September investigation known as Operation Carthage, in which NABU and SAPO accused officials connected to the Prosecutor General's Office of helping protect fraudulent call centers and laundering criminal proceeds. According to a Sept. 8 report in The Guardian, the investigation centered on fraudulent call centers whose employees impersonated banks, police officers and investment advisers to steal money from victims in Ukraine, Russia and Europe. NABU alleged that a senior official in the Prosecutor General's Office protected the operation and helped launder its proceeds. Law enforcement sources told Ukrainska Pravda that individual call centers paid approximately $7,000 a month in protection money. Investigators also released recordings suggesting that the principal suspect had overseen repairs at Kravchenko's home while allegedly collecting bribes. Kravchenko, who has not been charged in the investigation, denies wrongdoing and rejects the allegations against his office. He claimed the operation was intended to seize investigative materials concerning misconduct by anti-corruption officials and prevent him from pursuing those cases. He said he initially refused to resign but changed his position following a Sept. 7 meeting with Zelenskyy, attended, according to Kravchenko, by Davyd Arakhamia, leader of the president's parliamentary faction. "When the president wants your resignation and the leader of his parliamentary faction, which commands a majority, is sitting beside him, believe me: a prosecutor general's room for maneuver is extremely limited," he said. Zelenskyy publicly confirmed that he had demanded Kravchenko's removal. "There is only one path for this Prosecutor General: removal from office. That is what I told him," Zelenskyy said in a Sept. 14 statement, according to Reuters. Zelenskyy also said that if Kravchenko considered the decision political pressure, he was free to characterize it that way. The president suspended him on Sept. 14, and parliament approved his dismissal the following day. ZELENSKYY PRESSES US FOR EXPANDED RUSSIA TALKS AS KUSHNER ANNOUNCES BREAKTHROUGH Disputed investigation The confrontation intensified when Kravchenko announced on Sept. 14 that he had signed a notice of suspicion against Kryvonos over alleged misconduct predating his appointment as NABU director. Ukraine's Prosecutor General's Office disputed the validity of the notice, stating that Kryvonos had not been formally notified of suspicion under Ukrainian law and that relevant entries in the investigative register had been deleted. Kravchenko alleges those actions followed pressure from the president's administration. The claim remains unverified. NABU and SAPO have rejected Kravchenko's broader accusations, describing them as a campaign against independent anti-corruption institutions. In a Nov. 4 announcement, the agencies said Operation Carthage had uncovered an alleged criminal network involving senior law-enforcement officials accused of protecting fraudulent businesses. Those allegations have not been proven in court. The controversy comes amid widespread public concern about corruption. A September survey by the Kyiv International Institute of Sociology found that 72% of Ukrainians held Zelenskyy politically responsible for corruption among his associates, although the findings did not suggest respondents believed he was personally involved. Zelenskyy has publicly condemned the widening investigation's allegations. In a Nov. 7 address, he described alleged misconduct involving senior security officials as "frankly shameful, absolutely unacceptable," according to Reuters, and called for a full investigation. His former chief of staff, Andriy Yermak, defended him in an interview with the Axel Springer Global Reporters Network, amid an earlier corruption scandal in November 2025, describing Zelenskyy as "not corrupt" and saying he had allowed independent anti-corruption investigations. Zelenskyy's office did not respond to multiple requests from Fox News Digital for comment on Kravchenko's latest allegations. CLICK HERE TO DOWNLOAD THE FOX NEWS APP The former prosecutor general maintains that his removal prevented him from pursuing investigations into the leadership of the anti-corruption agencies. Ukrainian authorities, meanwhile, have publicly defended the investigation that preceded his dismissal.

articles.title: Child abduction survivor Elizabeth Smart says she was 'just the first of the seven' girls targeted
articles.summary: Elizabeth Smart reveals Brian David Mitchell planned to kidnap seven young girls under a "seven diamonds plus one" ideology she says was pure control.
articles.body: Elizabeth Smart, who survived a harrowing nine-month kidnapping as a teenager, opened up about her captor Brian David Mitchell's disturbing plans to abduct seven young girls as part of a twisted religious system. "He had a whole plan to go out and kidnap seven young girls," Smart told Sean Hannity on his "Hang Out With Sean Hannity" podcast. Smart explained that Mitchell and his wife followed an ideology centered on what they called the "seven diamonds plus one," which included their own set of scriptures and assigned roles to the women and girls involved. POLYGAMOUS SECT LEADER CONVICTED ON STATE CHARGES AFTER GIRLS FOUND IN UNVENTILATED TRAILER "She [the wife] was the one. And her role, her calling in life was to be the mother of Zion," Smart recalled. "She was the true queen. And I was her handmaiden. And I was just the first of the seven." Smart became one of America's most recognized child abduction survivors in 2002 after being forced from her Salt Lake City bedroom at knifepoint at age 14. Mitchell, a self-proclaimed prophet who called himself Immanuel David Isaiah, dragged her to a remote, dilapidated campsite in the woods, where his wife and accomplice, Wanda Barzee — who went by Hephzibah — was waiting. Barzee washed Smart’s feet, then tried to remove her pajamas. Mitchell declared, "I hereby seal you to me as my wife before God and His angels as my witnesses." When Smart screamed, Mitchell threatened to kill her. NANCY GUTHRIE UPDATE: 25 WEEKS AFTER ABDUCTION, ELIZABETH SMART SAYS THERE'S 'REASON TO HAVE HOPE' During her nine months in captivity, Smart endured repeated sexual assaults, was restrained and confined in a dark space and was forced to eat garbage. She was also subjected to pornography and forced to drink alcohol until she vomited, then left lying in her own vomit. Mitchell was convicted in federal court in 2010 and sentenced to life in prison in 2011. Barzee pleaded guilty and was released from prison in 2018. Now a child safety activist, Smart regularly speaks on behalf of missing and exploited children, drawing on her own experiences to help survivors of abuse. During her conversation with Hannity, Smart reflected on the ideology Mitchell used to justify his actions, suggesting his beliefs were a means of manipulating those around him rather than genuine belief. "I think he just wanted to rape little girls, but I think this is just how he was able to control Wanda Barzee," she said. Smart also said her religious upbringing was one of the reasons Mitchell singled her out, believing he could use her faith and young age to manipulate her. Viewers can watch or listen to Hannity's full conversation with Smart on the "Hang Out With Sean Hannity" podcast, available on YouTube, Spotify, Apple Podcasts and iHeartRadio. articles.title: In 2025, conservationists placed 20 reef cubes off northeast England; nine months later, 99% of the adult oysters attached to them were alive, as restoration work continued
articles.summary: Discover how marine conservationists successfully restored native oyster populations off northeast England, achieving a stunning 99% survival rate after just nine months. Learn about the innovative reef cubes and biodiversity improvements in this restoration project.
articles.body: Under the cold and turbulent waters of the North Sea, a vanished marine ecosystem quietly staged a comeback. In October 2025, marine conservationists from the Zoological Society of London (ZSL) teamed up with Groundwork North East & Cumbria to help native oysters thrive again off northeast England.According to a report by Groundwork, the team placed 20 reef cubes off the coast of Whitburn, South Tyneside, to rebuild the lost habitat. Nine months later, in July 2026, underwater surveys showed that 99% of the adult oysters attached to the reef cubes were still alive alongside sea urchins and crabs. Furthermore, the young oysters survived the harsh winter conditions despite low temperatures and food scarcity, showing positive signs for future reef growth.A new hub for marine life Apart from the oysters, the divers also observed a surge in local biodiversity. A wide variety of fish and crabs had moved into the oyster reef cubes and were thriving. The ecological benefits extended to the water itself. As cited by Groundwork, a single oyster filtered nearly 200 litres of water in a day, roughly equivalent to one full bathtub.For centuries, oysters had served as natural water purifiers while supporting other marine ecosystems. Native oyster reefs disappeared from northeast England nearly 100 years ago. Across the United Kingdom, the native oyster populations have fallen by more than 95% since the 1800s, due to over-harvesting, pollution, disease, and habitat loss.Restoration project and recovery steps Created as part of The Wild Oyster Project: Tyne and Wear, the one-hectare restoration project (approximately the size of 1.25 football fields) combined three key elements to kickstart the recovery process: oyster reef cubes, oysters, and scallop shells. For this phase of the project, 20 oyster reef cubes were supplied by ARC Marine Limited. These textured concrete blocks replicated the natural reefs and offered shelter for 4,000 adult oysters. Their central portholes also served as habitat for other sea creatures. Furthermore, the conservationists added 60,000 juvenile oysters to grow the next generation of reef. Moreover, the team spread 100 tonnes of scallop shells on the seabed, which provided the growing reef a stable base and laid the groundwork for the site's strong summer survey results.Planned next steps Following the July survey, the team began installing custom-designed cages into the central openings of the oyster reef cubes. Each cage contained a mix of young and adult oysters to establish several generations of oysters on the reef while minimizing the risk of predation during the initial period. Eleven months into the project, by September 10, 2026, the team had deployed an additional 1,000 mature native oysters and 15,000 spat-on-shell (juvenile oysters) to boost the restoration site.While the team continued to work with industrial experts, it was also looking at innovative approaches to native oyster restoration in the North Sea. The Oyster Restoration Company (TORC) supported this phase by contributing to the design and engineering of the inner cage inserts, alongside oyster production and supply.The team remained focused on monitoring, assessment, and management of the test site to maximise survival and promote long-term reef viability. With programme funding from the Stronger Shores initiative coming to an end in 2027, the team was working to secure further grant funding to scale up restoration efforts across the North East coast.You use AI every day. articles.title: French ex-President Nicolas Sarkozy and wife Carla Bruni to be tried next year
articles.summary: It is the latest case involving Nicolas Sarkozy who became the first French ex-president to go to jail last year.
articles.body:
Nicolas Sarkozy and his wife Carla Bruni-Sarkozy are to face trial next year over charges stemming from the former French president's conviction for conspiring to fund his election campaign with money from late Libyan dictator Muammar Gaddafi.

The charges centre on the retraction of the testimony of a key witness who had initially said he had evidence that could incriminate Sarkozy.

Sarkozy was given a five-year sentence in the case last September and became the first French ex-president to go to jail, even though he only spent 20 days behind bars. He has always denied doing anything wrong in the case and the appeals verdict is expected next Monday.

Since losing his re-election bid in 2012, Sarkozy has faced several criminal investigations.

In 2024, he was handed a one-year sentence – of which six months were suspended – over the illegal financing of his 2012 re-election campaign.

In 2021, he was found guilty of trying to bribe a judge and sentenced to three years in jail – two of them suspended – and thus became the first former French president to get a custodial sentence. He was allowed to serve his time at home wearing a tag instead of going to jail.

The new case centres on a Libyan businessman, Ziad Takieddine, who had said he had written proof that Sarkozy's 2007 campaign bid was "abundantly" financed by Tripoli, and that the €50m (£43m) in payments continued after he became president.

Takieddine, who died last year, withdrew his accusations in an interview in 2020.

At the time, Sarkozy was said to have stated: the "truth is finally coming out", but officials found the retraction to be "insincere" and a new investigation was launched into the "Save Sarko" file – the nickname the alleged perpetrators had used for the operation, according to French media.

So the former head of state and his wife, an Italian-born former supermodel and singer, will now face charges of "criminal conspiracy with intent to commit fraud" and benefiting from witness tampering. They deny any wrongdoing.

articles.title: Pip disability benefit review calls for closer link with claimant costs
articles.summary: A government-commissioned report calls for a "rebalancing" of the amount paid to different claimants.
articles.body:
The main disability benefit in England and Wales should be more closely linked to the additional costs claimants face, a government-commissioned review has recommended.

The review on personal independence payment (Pip) led by Disability Minister Sir Stephen Timms said the current system was "not appropriate" for claimants who do not have any extra costs arising from their condition.

The government has committed to some of its recommendations, including fast-track payments for people with severe conditions, but will not respond fully to the plans until early next year.

The Conservatives said the year-long review was a "compete farce" and showed a "complete absence of substance".

Shadow work and pensions secretary Helen Whately added: "All we have is a report that tinkers around the edges of a failed system".

Pip is available to people with long-term physical or mental health conditions who have difficulty doing every day tasks, regardless of whether they work, and it is not linked to income or savings.

The number of people claiming Pip in England and Wales has roughly doubled since 2019 to around four million.

The Timms review was set up last year by Sir Keir Starmer's government after his aborted attempt to cut welfare spending, which was derailed by the threat of a rebellion by Labour MPs.

It was co-produced with groups representing disabled people, who had a role in drafting the report.

Key takeaways from the Timms review into Pip disability benefit

Giving a statement in the House of Commons, Sir Stephen said Pip "remains a vital source of support" but the system was "no longer fit for purpose".

He told MPs the current assessment process was "dehumanising" and focused on "what somebody cannot do", rather than "supporting independence".

The government has committed to a recommendation that people receiving end-of-life care or with "serious, well-evidenced conditions" would receive payments without a full assessment.

It has also agreed to reduce "unnecessary" reviews for people whose conditions are lifelong or unlikely to improve.

Under the report's proposals, cash payments would remain alongside better support to signpost people into education or employment, although claimants could choose to exchange part of their payment for practical services instead.

In the longer-term, the report recommends changes to the assessment process that look at someone's real-life additional costs and individual needs, focusing on "how people can live the life they want to live, rather than what they cannot do".

It proposes "improved" questions to understand the extra costs people face, although claimants would not be asked to calculate their costs or provide receipts.

Currently eligibility for Pip is based on how difficult people find carrying out everyday tasks, with two levels of payment available.

But the review suggests future payment options could include bands more closely linked to extra costs.

The report says its approach is likely to lead to a "rebalancing" of payments, indicating that some claimants could lose out under a new system, either receiving less than they do currently or not qualifying for payments at all.

"Those with the highest additional costs, and so the most significant needs, should receive the most support," it says.

"Conversely, this benefit is not appropriate for those who do not incur any additional costs associated with being disabled."

The review also calls for an increase in face-to-face assessments, which has been show to reduce eligibility.

The remit of the review was not to produce savings, and it does not set out whether the reforms would reduce the overall welfare bill.

Spending on Pip is set to be about £32bn this financial year, a figure projected to rise to £41.5bn by the end of the decade.

It comes after a separate review by former minister Alan Milburn into young people not in education, employment or training (Neets).

The government welcomed Milburn's report , which included a recommendation to move under-25s off Pip and the health element of universal credit, and onto an entirely new benefits system.

This has lead to concerns about a two-tier system, where some people with the same conditions could get different levels of payments depending on their age.

The government has said it will consider the Timms review alongside Milburn's recommendations, with its final proposals set out early next year.

Sir Stephen said this would include detailing the overall costs of changes to the system.

At a glance: Key proposals from Milburn's Neets report

Eduin Latimer, senior research economist at the Institute for Fiscal Studies think tank, said the review's recommendations had "the potential to better tailor Pip to claimants' needs".

But he said this would also create challenges, "most importantly in defining what disability-related costs are included, and finding a fair way of measuring them".

Latimer said making it easier to apply for Pip in its current form would "likely increase the number of claimants - and hence spending".

He added: "If the government wants to make Pip easier to apply for while also keeping spending in line with current projections, they would likely have to tighten eligibility criteria or reduce award amounts."

Disability charities have largely welcomed the review's recommendations of fast-tracked support and fewer reassessments.

However, they have said any changes should not leave disabled people financially worse off.

The Liberal Democrats said younger disabled people would now face "months of uncertainty" whilst the government considers the separate reviews from Timms and Milburn, and urged ministers to say quickly what they intend to do.

Reform UK's Treasury spokesman Robert Jenrick said: "Timms' recommendations will not cut the ballooning benefits bill so taxes on working people will inevitably rise."

He said his party would "bring back rigorous in-person assessments and ensure benefits are only available for British people" in order to lower the welfare bill.

The disability benefit system is devolved in Scotland and will not change in line with England and Wales. However, the Timms Review could impact the funding the Scottish government receives.

Disability benefits are also devolved in Northern Ireland, but in practice it reflects any changes made to the system in England and Wales.

articles.title: Brighton Wheel lease jeopardises i360 future, owner says
articles.summary: Sarah Willingham says she is worried about the Brighton i360's future, criticising the city council.
articles.body:
The owner of the Brighton i360 says she is "really worried about the future" of the attraction after a lease was granted for a seafront ferris wheel to return.

Sarah Willingham, who bought the viewing tower in 2024 after it went into administration, says Brighton and Hove City Council have "put the future of the i360 in jeopardy" by granting a 25-year lease for the Brighton Wheel to return as early as 2027.

Willingham, speaking ahead of a meeting to discuss the lessons learned from the council's involvement in the i360's finances , said Brighton "can't sustain" two paid viewing attractions.

Council deputy leader Jacob Taylor said the wheel will bring a "strong financial income to the council".

Willingham told BBC South East: "People won't go up both, there's not enough to see, frankly."

She added: "If you asked me a year ago, everyone was so supportive of us taking the i360 and putting our love into it.

"In that one decision, the council has put the future of the Brighton i360 in jeopardy.

"I'm really worried for the future of the i360. I know that it can be a success for Brighton itself."

The Brighton Wheel previously closed in 2016 when the i360 opened, but has been granted a new lease to reopen on its previous site in Madeira Drive.

A planning application needs to be submitted for the wheel to be rebuilt, and Brighton and Hove City Council says it will receive a guaranteed income for the duration of the lease, through the commercial rent on the site.

The sale of the i360 to Nightcap Ltd, owned by Willingham, was facilitated by a £51m loan write off by the city council, who had originally agreed to lend £36m to previous owners Brighton i360 Ltd in 2014.

The council is paying off the loan at £2.2m a year until 2041.

A report by the Chartered Institute of Public Finance and Accountancy report found the council had been presented with "overly ambitious" financial and visitor number projections when it agreed the loan.

The council's audit, standards and general purposes committee is due to discuss the report on Tuesday.

In response to Willingham's comments, council deputy leader Jacob Taylor said it was "disappointing to hear grumbling from a private business that has benefited from a publicly-funded write off of a £51m loan".

On the report, he added: "It's important that the council learns the lesson of a very, very significant financial loss for the people of Brighton.

"We have got to be serious about it and not make a mistake of this scale again."

articles.title: Samsung heiress Lee Boo-jin's son drops father's surname, adopts mother's family name after turning 19
articles.summary: The son of Hotel Shilla CEO Lee Boo-jin, a member of South Korea's powerful Samsung founding family, has legally changed his surname from his father's to
articles.body: The son of Hotel Shilla CEO Lee Boo-jin, a member of South Korea's powerful Samsung founding family, has legally changed his surname from his father's to his mother's after turning 19. Lee Dong-hyun, formerly known as Lim Dong-hyun, received approval from the Seoul Family Court to adopt his mother's surname, Lee, and her ancestral family origin, according to South Korean media reports.The 19-year-old filed the petition himself in August, shortly after reaching legal adulthood. The court's Family Division 21, presided over by Judge Park Mi-hwa, approved his request in late October.During the proceedings, the court also sought the opinion of his father, Lim Woo-jae, a former adviser to Samsung Electro-Mechanics.Under Article 781, Paragraph 6 of South Korea's Civil Act, a person's surname and ancestral family origin can be changed with court approval if the move is considered necessary for the person's welfare. Either a parent or the child can file such a petition. The change does not affect the existing legal parent-child relationship, meaning Dong-hyun remains legally recognised as the son of his biological father.Why did Lee Boo-jin's son change his surname?Lee Boo-jin married Lim Woo-jae in August 1999, and the couple had one son. Their marriage eventually ended in a lengthy and high-profile divorce battle. Lee filed for divorce mediation in 2014, but the proceedings continued for several years. Their divorce was finalized in January 2020 after South Korea's Supreme Court upheld a ruling in Lee's favour. The court granted Lee custody of their son and parental authority over him. Dong-hyun was raised by his mother.Following the surname change, he has also adopted the Gyeongju Lee clan origin, which is shared by his mother.In South Korea, people with the same surname are traditionally distinguished by their ancestral family origin, known as bon-gwan, which identifies the clan's geographical and historical roots.Who is Lee Boo-jin?Lee Boo-jin is the daughter of late Samsung Group chairman Lee Kun-hee and the younger sister of Samsung Electronics chairman Lee Jae-yong. She heads Hotel Shilla, the luxury hotel and duty-free business affiliated with Samsung Group, and is among South Korea's most prominent businesswomen.Her son graduated from Seoul's prestigious Whimoon High School in February 2026 and is now studying economics at Seoul National University.Lee's former husband, Lim Woo-jae, previously worked as an adviser at Samsung Electro-Mechanics.South Korea's law on changing surnamesSouth Korean law allows children to adopt their mother's surname instead of their father's with court permission when the change is considered necessary for their welfare. The provision was introduced as part of amendments to the Civil Act that took effect in 2008, following the abolition of the country's traditional patriarchal family-head system. Courts can consider the views of parents and children aged 13 or older when deciding such applications. The surname change does not terminate or alter the legal relationship with either biological parent.You use AI every day. Now get your AI Quotient. Take the AIQ test.

articles.summary: SRINAGAR/JAMMU: Amid the row over BRO’s construction work near the 11,780-foot-high Sheshnag Lake in Jammu & Kashmir, PDP chief Mehbooba Mufti Tuesday
articles.body: SRINAGAR/JAMMU: Amid the row over BRO’s construction work near the 11,780-foot-high Sheshnag Lake in Jammu & Kashmir, PDP chief Mehbooba Mufti Tuesday attempted to trek to the spot but was stopped by police at Chandanwari, some 12 kms from the site.“My worst fears were confirmed today when police stopped me from proceeding towards Sheshnag. The questions surrounding construction in this fragile glacial ecosystem are only growing louder. What is being concealed today could become a man-made disaster tomorrow. The Amarnath cave, yatra route and surrounding mountains must be protected as one ecological whole,” Mehbooba said.After a video of an earthmover purportedly near Sheshnag began circulating, the BRO (Border Roads Organisation) had clarified it was only carrying out post-Amarnath Yatra works in compliance with all applicable safety and environmental norms and its primary objective was to safeguard pilgrims throughout the yatra.MLA Hasnian Masoodi of the governing National Conference, however, rejected the BRO’s response. “If the track is being made safer, why are earthmovers being taken over there? This shouldn’t happen,” he added.Environmental activists say Sheshnag is a glacial lake and an ecologically fragile zone surrounded by steep slopes and glacial deposits. The lake is the source of the Lidder river, which flows downstream to Pahalgam and beyond into the Kashmir Valley. Sheshnag is among 14 high-risk glacial lakes identified in Jammu & Kashmir.Environmental activist Raja Muzaffar Bhat warned that constructing a road around the Sheshnag glacier would be an environmental disaster. “More and more people must approach the Supreme Court, the National Green Tribunal (NGT) or the high court,” he said.On Monday, Congress MP and spokesperson Pawan Khera had said Sheshnag was not a construction site but a fragile Himalayan ecosystem and a sacred lake for both Hindus and Muslims.Meanwhile, BJP has defended the project, accusing Kashmir-based political parties and the Congress of communalising the issue.State BJP spokesperson Girdhari Lal Raina said certain political elements seem to have found a new pretext to communalise the atmosphere in the Amarnath Yatra track-widening issue.
